code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    colors = sorted(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg))
    boundary = max(colors, key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    seed = next(x for x in colors if x != boundary)
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v == seed:
                out[r][c] = 4
                for j in range(c+1,len(row)):
                    if grid[r][j] == boundary: break
                    out[r][j] = seed
        if row[0] == boundary:
            for c in range(1,len(row)):
                if row[c] == boundary: break
                out[r][c] = seed
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
# apply test
